speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
text: asked the Minister for Manpower when will the next review of safe management measures at the workplace be conducted and what will be the considerations in such a review.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Speaker, in January, safe management measures (SMMs) in the general community setting were tightened.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This was due to a rise in the number of community cases then, and in view of the anticipated increase in social activities during the Chinese New Year.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: As we have seen from the resurgence of infections in some countries in the region, we must remain vigilant in our approach to managing the transmission risks.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: First, the reason why I raised this is because I know that many businesses, employers in various workplaces, they are still suffering.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: We all understand the need to be conservative and to stay vigilant.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: And hence, my first supplementary question is could Minister of State give an indication of when this review will take place?

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: Is there a specific timeline and whether vaccination is going to be a factor in the considerations?

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: Obviously, I hope that in weighing the interests between business and health, both are equally important that we strike the right calibration.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, that changes the corporate culture a bit.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: At the same time as well, we have seen employees, many have adjusted well at home with the new arrangements.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: But at the same time as well, some also still prefer to work in the office if their home environment is not conducive.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: This is quite key because, how we adjust the work-from-home requirement will have to take into consideration the public health risks.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: At the same time as well, we need to also look at how community cases develop, especially after the Chinese New Year period.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: We will monitor the situation and try to balance as much as we can the employers' as well as the employees' interests.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Therefore, there are few factors still in play, as vaccinations are still on-going.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, let us what with the Multi-Ministry Task Force and see how best we can manage and adjust and cater to both employers and employees.
